prompt:
Feature: operators want to pause and resume queued jobs.

- New job status `paused`. Only a queued job can be paused; a paused job can be resumed
  (it goes back to `queued`) or cancelled.
- API: `POST /jobs/:id/pause` and `POST /jobs/:id/resume`, both requiring the
  `jobs:write` scope. 200 with the job on success, 409 when the transition isn't allowed.
  `GET /jobs?status=paused` has to work.
- A paused job has no upcoming run (`nextRunAt: null`).
- CLI: `jobs pause <id>` and `jobs resume <id>` print `Paused <id> (now PAUSED)` and
  `Resumed <id> (now QUEUED)`.

solution.find: import { cancelJob, createJob, getJob, listJobs, retryJob } from "./jobs.ts";
solution.replace: import { cancelJob, createJob, getJob, listJobs, pauseJob, resumeJob, retryJob } from "./jobs.ts";
